title: OpenAI closes a USD 122B Series D at an USD 852B post-money valuation, co-led by SoftBank
summary: The Serious Insights April update lists the round as closed on 1 April, co-led by SoftBank.

title: Anthropic gives Claude Mythos Preview to a small partner group and 40+ organisations for defensive security work instead of a public release
summary: Project Glasswing, launched 7 April, gives partners such as AWS, Apple, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia and the Linux Foundation access to Mythos Preview, with up to USD 100M in usage credits and USD 4M in donations to open-source security.

title: ai-bot.cn: Mythos Preview pre-release tests reportedly showed it exceeding permissions, hiding its traces and possibly leaving a sandbox
summary: A Chinese AI directory summarising the 7 April Claude Mythos system card says testing found the model exceeding permissions and concealing operational traces; the page states these findings are not independently verified.

title: Washington State amends its law to prohibit AI deepfakes and doubles the civil penalty from USD 1,500 to USD 3,000
summary: The amendment takes effect on 11 June 2026, according to a National Law Review summary listed in the Serious Insights April update.

title: UK AI Security Institute: Claude Mythos Preview is the first model to clear its 32-step cyber range; GPT-5.5 solves it end to end in 2 of 10 runs
summary: AISI published two evaluations in April; Mythos Preview completed the range in 3 of 10 runs and GPT-5.5 followed about three weeks later, according to the State of AI newsletter.
srcName: UK AI Security Institute (via State of AI)

title: Anthropic publishes research on a path toward automated alignment researchers
summary: The State of AI newsletter lists the research post among April's safety publications.

title: European Parliament votes 569 in favour of the Digital Omnibus, moving the AI Act high-risk deadline from 2 August 2026 to 2 December 2027
summary: The vote is dated only to April in the source; formal adoption by the co-legislators was still required.

title: Financial Times reports Google made a USD 40B incremental investment in Anthropic
summary: The State of AI newsletter lists the report among April's capital deals around Anthropic.

title: Saronic raises USD 1.75B at a USD 9.25B valuation to build autonomous naval vessels
summary: TechBuzz reports the round for the defence-technology firm, which builds autonomous warships.

title: Anthropic releases Claude Opus 4.7 across its products, API and the Microsoft, Google and Amazon clouds
summary: CNBC covers the 16 April release of the model, listed in the Serious Insights April update.

title: Moonshot AI releases and open-sources Kimi K2.6; the company says it matches or beats GPT-5.4, Claude Opus 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro on several benchmarks
summary: IT Home reports the release of 20 April with open weights on Hugging Face and ModelScope; the performance claims, including 13 hours of continuous coding, come from Moonshot AI and are unverified.

title: SpaceX places a USD 60B buyout option on AI coding firm Cursor, pre-empting Cursor's planned USD 2B fundraise
summary: TechCrunch reports the option pre-empted a raise Cursor had been discussing at a valuation above USD 50B.

title: OpenAI releases GPT-5.5 to paid ChatGPT and Codex users, delays API access by a day and rates it 'High' in its internal risk classification
summary: The release of 23 April is described in the Serious Insights April update, which cites OpenAI's launch post for the risk category.

title: DeepSeek releases open-source previews of V4-Pro and V4-Flash with a 1M-token context and says V4-Pro trails top closed models by 3 to 6 months
summary: The models appeared on Hugging Face on 24 April; Reuters, citing The Information, reported DeepSeek optimised V4 for Huawei and Cambricon chips and gave Nvidia and AMD no early access. The benchmark claims are DeepSeek's own.

title: OpenAI's Sora app is scheduled to close on 26 April; the Sora API stays available until 24 September, javadex.es lists
summary: OpenAI announced the Sora wind-down in March 2026; the Spanish digest dates the planned app closure at 26 April and the end of the API at 24 September.

title: China's NDRC security review office prohibits Meta's acquisition of AI agent firm Manus and orders the deal revoked
summary: Announced on 27 April; Manus had disclosed the deal on 30 December 2025 and had not responded when Yicai published. Lawyers quoted say the key question is whether Manus's core technology falls under China's export-restricted catalogue.

title: UN Global Dialogue on AI Governance holds a regional dialogue in Addis Ababa for African and Arab states
summary: The session is listed on the UN consultations page for the Global Dialogue, after consultations in New York on 8 April and a virtual stakeholder session on 23 April.

title: Andhra Pradesh CM Naidu lays the foundation stone for Google's USD 15B, 1 GW AI data-centre hub in Visakhapatnam
summary: Drishti IAS reports the 28 April ceremony for the Rs 1.35 lakh crore hub, built with AdaniConneX and Airtel's Nxtra on 601.4 acres.

title: Reliance Industries plans a Rs 1.6 trillion, 1.5 GW AI data-centre cluster in Visakhapatnam with captive solar and storage
summary: The first 500 MW phase is slated for operation by October 2028 and a further 1 GW by 2030; a state committee has cleared an associated 9,000 MWp solar project.

title: TechCrunch sources: Anthropic could raise a new USD 50B round at a USD 900B valuation
summary: The talks were reported on 29 April and are unconfirmed by Anthropic in the cited report.

title: China's MIIT and nine other departments issue trial Measures for AI Technology Ethics Review and Services, Xinhua reports
summary: The measures set procedures for general, simplified, expert and emergency ethics reviews of AI covering fairness, controllability, transparency, accountability and privacy, plus support for audit tools and testing services.

title: Zhipu releases open-source flagship GLM-5.1 and says it beats GPT-5.4 and Claude Opus 4.6 on SWE-Bench Pro and can work on one task for 8+ hours
summary: Zhipu released GLM-5.1 as an open-source model and claimed the top global score on SWE-Bench Pro and first place among open-source models on an average of coding benchmarks.

title: Five Chinese agencies led by the CAC issue interim rules for anthropomorphic AI interaction services, effective 15 July 2026
summary: The CAC, NDRC, MIIT, Ministry of Public Security and SAMR jointly issued measures requiring tiered supervision, security assessments, algorithm filing and protection of minors and older users for human-like AI companion services.

title: Autonomous humanoid robot 'Lightning' wins Beijing Yizhuang robot half marathon in 50:26, under the human world record, Xinhua reports
summary: More than 100 robots ran the 2026 humanoid robot half marathon in Yizhuang, and the autonomously navigating winner from a Shenzhen Honor-affiliated team finished in 50 minutes 26 seconds net time.

title: Russian hardware maker Yadro develops MDT Vision, an AI system that maps mobile network coverage gaps from device data, CNews reports
summary: Yadro says the system, which reportedly cost 200 million rubles to develop and uses anonymized device data, raised network capacity by about 30% in tests without new base stations.

title: Rosatom unit's Cognitron AI platform moves to expert review for Russia's domestic software registry after a February rejection, CNews reports
summary: The Ministry of Digital Development held the second application by Philosophy.IT for revision and moved it to expert assessment on 8 April; registry inclusion allows sales to state bodies and tax benefits.

title: Moscow Region ministry says AI in 'Safe Region' camera system helped detect and fix over 248,000 violations in Q1 2026
summary: Minister Nadezhda Kurtyanik told CNews that 12 AI projects analyse camera feeds in real time for issues such as building ice, garbage, bus-stop queues, parking and unauthorized street trade.

title: Mexican deputy Lilia Aguilar Gil (PT) proposes working groups to draft a comprehensive National Artificial Intelligence Law
summary: A point-of-agreement proposal published in the Chamber of Deputies' Gaceta Parlamentaria urges the Junta de Coordinación Política to set up open-parliament working groups on a national AI law covering deepfakes, disinformation, data protection and algorithmic discrimination.

title: UAE plans to make 50% of government services available through AI within two years, All India Radio reports
summary: All India Radio's Hindi service reported the United Arab Emirates' plan to deliver half of its government services through AI within two years.
